title: akitaonrails/ai-memory
claim: akitaonrails/ai-memory — Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
why_good: ai-memory is a long-term memory solution for AI coding agents, providing a shared memory store and automatic context capture via lifecycle hooks. It supports 15+ agents and enables seamless handoff between different agent vendors, so you can quit one agent and continue in another without losing context.
value: Solo developers and small teams pay for ai-memory to eliminate context loss when switching between AI coding agents, saving hours per week and reducing frustration.
risk: The risk is that a major agent vendor (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) adds built-in cross-agent memory, making ai-memory obsolete.

voices.quote: …per human-perceived session — and it unconditionally fetches+consumes any pending handoff every time it fires (`ai_memory_get_handoff`, no guard). The result: a handoff created while an Antigravity session is still looping gets imme…

does: ai-memory is a long-term memory solution for AI coding agents, providing a shared memory store and automatic context capture via lifecycle hooks. It supports 15+ agents and enables seamless handoff between different agent vendors, so you can quit one agent and continue in another without losing context.
why_use: Unlike manual context management or per-agent memory, ai-memory automatically captures and injects context across agents, solving the pain of re-explaining. It's the only tool with this breadth of agent support and lifecycle hook integration, making it the default choice for multi-agent workflows.
gap: It's a developer tool with no productized interface for non-technical users to manage agent memory.
counter: This could be a feature of the agents themselves—Claude Code or Codex could add cross-agent memory natively, killing the need for a third-party tool. Also, the project is young (created 2026-05-21) and may not have enough traction to sustain a company.
differentiator: Package ai-memory as a one-command install with automatic agent detection and a simple GUI dashboard, targeting non-technical solo founders who want zero-config setup.
hook: Solo developers and small teams who switch between Claude Code, Codex, and other AI coding agents are in pain because every switch means re-explaining the architecture, failed approaches, and open questions, wasting hour

zh.claim: 为AI编码代理提供长期记忆，支持跨代理无缝切换，避免重复解释架构和失败方法。
zh.hook: 在Claude Code、Codex等多个AI编码代理之间切换的独立开发者和小团队，每次切换都要重新解释架构、失败方法和未决问题，浪费大量时间，痛苦不堪。
zh.does: ai-memory是AI编码代理的长期记忆解决方案，通过生命周期钩子自动捕获上下文，支持15+代理，实现跨厂商无缝交接，让你在一个代理中退出，在另一个代理中继续，无需丢失上下文。
zh.why_use: 与手动上下文管理或单代理记忆不同，ai-memory自动跨代理捕获和注入上下文，解决了重复解释的痛苦。它是唯一具有如此广泛代理支持和生命周期钩子集成的工具，是多代理工作流的事实标准。
zh.gap: 当前解决方案安装和配置复杂，需要为每个代理设置MCP和钩子，只有极客才能使用。缺乏完善的产品或托管服务，为更简单的即插即用解决方案留出空间。
zh.counter: 这可能是代理本身的功能——Claude Code或Codex可以原生添加跨代理记忆，从而消灭第三方工具的需求。此外，项目还很年轻（2026-05-21创建），可能没有足够的牵引力来支撑一家公司。
zh.differentiator: 将ai-memory打包成一键安装，自动检测代理并提供简单GUI仪表盘，面向非技术型独立创始人，实现零配置。
zh.value: 独立开发者和小团队付费使用ai-memory，以消除在AI编码代理之间切换时的上下文丢失，每周节省数小时并减少挫败感。
zh.risk: 风险在于主要代理供应商（如OpenAI、Anthropic）会内置跨代理记忆，使ai-memory过时。
zh.why_good: ai-memory是AI编码代理的长期记忆解决方案，通过生命周期钩子自动捕获上下文，支持15+代理，实现跨厂商无缝交接，让你在一个代理中退出，在另一个代理中继续，无需丢失上下文。

pick_reason: Strong demand evidence but the gap is not yet a clear consumer opportunity.
